memory_candidates.content: In a `List.map (fun i p => decide (c p (a + i))) (List.range n)` with `a : ℤ`, type the binder `(i : ℕ)` explicitly: otherwise `i : ℤ` is inferred and Lean coerces the whole `List ℕ` to `List ℤ` via a monadic lift (`do let a ← List.range n; pure ↑a`), which breaks every `List.getElem_map`/`getElem_range` rewrite.

`l[i]'h p` parses as `l[i]'(h p)`-ish and fails with 'has type α but expected Prop'; write `(l[i]'h) p`. Also `simp`/`rw` will not rewrite under a `getElem` whose bound proof is typed against a folded definition — restate the bound against the unfolded list (`have hi' : i < (unfolded).length := hi; change (unfolded)[i]'hi' …`) first.
`lean_multi_attempt`'s whole-file diagnostics can come back empty while the scoped `lake build` still fails; treat the build log, not the LSP sweep, as the phase-closure authority.
